description: Break a complex multi-city itinerary into its individual legs and show where a consultant adds value: which legs are routine, which need expertise (Gulf bridge connections, surface sectors, long-haul gaps), and how complex the trip is to ticket. It does not choose airlines and gives no prices - use route_estimate for a price range. Use it for any route with 4+ stops, backtracking, or region combinations that alliance fares can't cover.

budget.description: Budget tier the traveler asked for

cities.description: Ordered list of IATA city/airport codes (e.g. ['LAX', 'NRT', 'BKK', 'CMB', 'NBO', 'LIS', 'LAX'])

name: custom_route_build
title: Build a Custom Segmented Route
